text:
rachel: heads-up, Sentinel POC is failing on rerank. getting a hard 400. pasting the client error and the two calls we make

samir: error from our node app: `400 Bad Request - embedding_dim_unexpected: got 768, expected 1536` when hitting /api/v1/rerank

samir: flow is: call /api/v1/embeddings with model `embed-lite-768` -> get arrays length 768 -> send documents to `/rerank` which is configured in the console by the sales template

rachel: what's the rerank route pinned to in the console?

maya: quick check: our template pins rerank -> `embedding-rerank-v2` (server side) which expects 1536-d embeddings. mismatch for sure.

samir: here's a redacted request/response from the client logs:```
POST /v1/embeddings
body: { model: "embed-lite-768", input: ["doc1","doc2"] }
response: { embeddings: [[...768 floats...],[...768 floats...]] }

POST /v1/rerank
body: { model: "embedding-rerank-v2", documents: [[...768 floats...]] }
response: 400 embedding_dim_unexpected: expected 1536
```

tom: two straightforward fixes: (A) change the encoder call to a 1536-d model to match rerank, or (B) reconfigure the rerank route to accept 768-d vectors (route to a compatible model variant).

samir: option A likely easiest for the demo. question: does switching to the larger embed model blow our credits?

jess: yes, `embed-large-1536` costs ~2.5x per embedding vs `embed-lite-768`. for a short demo we can add a $200 credit bump to the account. msg me the acct id and i'll approve. :+1:

rachel: we also ran into occasional 429 spikes when batching ~120 docs in one request; logs show `RateLimitError: batch_item_limit exceeded (max_items=50)`

maya: on hosted plans our current soft limit is 50 items per embedding request for large models. push >50 and you'll see 429s. recommended client-side: batch <=32 for stable throughput, or enable streaming batching if you need higher concurrency.

samir: what's a good retry/backoff to use? we retry immediately now which makes things worse.

maya: use exponential backoff + jitter. recommended: base=200ms, multiplier=2, max=6s with full jitter. also add an `Idempotency-Key` header so retries are safe.

tom: also validate lengths before calling rerank to fail fast. tiny snippet:```
if (vec.length !== expectedDim) throw new Error(`dim mismatch: ${vec.length} != ${expectedDim}`)
```

samir: curious — can we do an automatic down-projection (server-side) if dims don't match? would be neat for POC.

maya: we don't auto-project embeddings for rerank (quality risk). short-term we can add a compatibility route that accepts 768 and projects to 1536 via a learned transform, but that's an opt-in feature and not enabled for trials. for the demo, align models client-side.

rachel: security asked whether embeddings end up in logs and retention window for trial accounts.

ops-bot: notice: by default logs are retained 14 days for trial accounts; embeddings fields are redacted in logs unless customer opts in. For enterprise/private we support custom retention and can disable embedding logging entirely.

jess: i'll draft a one-paragraph answer for the security questionnaire and email it to Sentinel's security contact. also confirming the $200 credit.

samir: after switching the encoder to `embed-large-1536` and dropping batch_size to 32 the rerank calls succeeded — no dim errors and 429s stopped. thanks.

maya: great. follow-ups: 1) add a preflight vector-length check and metric for 429s on your side, 2) set client batching to 32 and backoff per above, 3) jess will send credit + security blurb.

rachel: can ops provision dedicated capacity for the demo window? latency matters for the client.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: Dedicated capacity request queued for POC sentinel-dc-4520. ETA ~90 minutes.

rachel: perfect — leaving this thread open in case anything else appears. ping me if you see regressions or need the security blurb.
